full_page.content:
1955, January 15
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solenus Casey, C. F.M. Cap.
SAINT FELIX CAPUCHIN FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA January 15th, 1955
Blessed be God in all His designs!
God bless you Miss Krausman. Many thanks for your favor of some weeks past - I wanted to write you for Christmas but that be- came just impossible. I am glad to learn that notwithstanding the many difficulties your dear ones meet with, still in general things seem to improve anyhow.
So God bless you - Dad and little Mary Jane and all - to all a Blessed New Year.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
